name: Singapore Noodles with Prawns
method: Put the noodles in a bowl, cover with boiling water and leave for 3 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water. Slice the onion and pepper, chop the chilli, crush the garlic and cut the green beans into thirds.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan until very hot. Add the onion, garlic and chilli and stir fry for 2 minutes, then add the curry powder and fry for 1 minute.
Add a splash of water, then the green beans and pepper, and stir fry for 4 to 5 minutes until just tender. Add the spinach and let it wilt.
Add the cooked prawns and heat them through for 2 minutes, then add the noodles and crushed nuts and toss everything together.
Take off the heat, splash over the soy sauce and serve in two bowls.
